title: ID0390468-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R9 170002656] need access to Sifinity control
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I recently made a ticket to create a acces for the customer "mobilityPlus" an access to Sifinity Control. The invitation was send on friday but was only valid for 48h. The customer did not have the time to accept it. Can it be re-send?
Root cause: Invite link expired
Solution:  Sifinity team provided the link again (API)
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: 9/7/2025
